consensus_summary: Package-level consensus is conservatively SPLIT because the five cards contain no per-seat editorial recommendations; no decision ballot or independent convergence is inferred. The domain/totality defect is corroborated by R1, R2, and DA without being promoted to CONSENSUS-3 or CONSENSUS-4.
dissenting_opinions: No explicit cross-card contradiction was recorded; SPLIT marks unavailable per-seat decision consensus rather than fabricated opposition, and silence was not treated as disagreement.
